description: In an AutoHide dock, starting keyboard navigation with the Focus Dock action keeps the dock visible and focused outside the dock, then hides it again after Escape.

assertions.comment: The first dock icon has focus when keyboard navigation starts
Pressing Right moves focus to the second icon, confirming that key input reaches the dock
After moving to the second icon, the first icon’s keyboard focus is cleared
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) remains fully visible during keyboard navigation without pointer hover
During keyboard navigation, the panel does not move to the AutoHide hidden position and stays at visible position y=36
Pressing Escape clears the second icon’s keyboard focus, confirming that navigation ended
After navigation ends, the pointer is outside the dock, so the panel hides again under the AutoHide policy
